name: zinput_bindmap_context_get_command_by_primary_key
description: zInput_BindMapContext::GetCommandByPrimaryKey returns the command id recorded in the primary keyboard reverse lookup table.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x470ac0 loads keyboardKey from the stack and returns self->m_primaryKeyToCommand[keyboardKey] from this + 0x14.

Native smoke zinput_bindmap_context_smoke verifies direct context lookup after RebuildLookupIndices clears a primary key mapping, and verifies current-context primary-key lookup after binding records and SetPrimaryKeyBinding update the reverse lookup table.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x470ac0 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a zInput bind-map accessor pass.
